caption: The drawing features a wooden shovel with a wide, rectangular scoop and a short handle. The handle has a D-shaped grip at the top, and both the grip and shaft are rendered in light to medium brown tones, imitating the natural grain and texture of wood. The scoop portion is broadly rectangular with rounded edges and visible wood grain details, and there is a small chipped section on the lower right edge. The background is plain and light in color, providing contrast to the shovel, which is centrally positioned and depicted without any additional objects or elements.
title: Wooden Shovel
